resources.local_daemon_offline_hint: Start the local daemon to attach a directory on this machine.
resources.local_daemon_already_attached_hint: This machine already has a local directory attached. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_no_daemon_tooltip: Local daemon isn't reporting an ID yet — the agent can't open this directory.
resources.local_other_machine_tooltip: Only available on the machine that registered this directory.
resources.chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
resources.chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each run hands its work back as an agent/… branch.
resources.toast_local_already_attached: This directory is already attached to the project on this machine.
resources.toast_local_daemon_already_attached: This machine already has a local directory attached to this project. Remove it before adding another.
resources.local_validate_unsupported: Local directories can only be picked on the desktop app.
resources.mode_dialog_title: How should runs use this folder?
resources.mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether runs on this folder can execute at the same time.
resources.mode_in_place_description: One run at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
resources.mode_worktree_description: Runs execute at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
resources.mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Multica server is too old to execute runs in parallel — it would quietly execute them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
resources.mode_edit_tooltip: Change how runs use this folder
resources.mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Runs execute at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
resources.toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode

delete_dialog.title: Delete project
delete_dialog.description: This will delete the project. Issues will not be deleted but will be unlinked.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.source_title: How would you like to build the workflow?
workflow.source_hint: Build your own, or start from an existing workflow.
workflow.blank_hint: Add statuses and decide who handles each step.
workflow.templates_hint: Choose a reusable workflow, then assign participants.
workflow.copy_hint: Copy statuses and handoff rules, without issues or run history.
workflow.simple_hint: Track work manually from start to finish.
workflow.development_hint: Agents develop and review; people confirm handoffs.
workflow.develop_prompt: Implement the issue requirements, verify key behavior, and report the result. Wait for human confirmation before advancing.
workflow.review_prompt: Review the implementation against the requirements. Report concrete findings and evidence. Leave the decision to advance to a human.
workflow.editor_hint: Each issue moves through these statuses independently.
workflow.replace_warning: Choosing another source replaces the statuses in this draft.
workflow.auto_hint: Starts the selected executor when an issue enters this status.
workflow.manual_hint: Handled manually, with no automatic run.
workflow.reorder_hint: Reordering connects the statuses in their new order. Set a different next status in the details if needed.
workflow.create_hint: Creating a project does not start any agent.
workflow.draft_hint: Incomplete settings stay in your local draft when you close this dialog.
workflow.apply_hint: Running executions keep their original rules. Saved changes apply on the next status entry.
workflow.inherited_hint: New issues will use this project workflow. Existing issues keep their current workflow binding.
workflow.removed_hint: Removed statuses will be archived. Existing issues stay in those statuses until moved manually.
workflow.save_error: Could not save. Your draft is preserved. If the workflow changed, reload it before editing again.
workflow.copy_independent: Changes to this copy will not affect the original project.
workflow.terminal_hint: Entering this status ends the issue.
workflow.initial_auto_hint: New issues start the configured executor immediately in the starting status.

problems.name: Status names must contain 1–64 characters.
problems.executor: Choose a participant for this status.

workflow_rules.title: Workflow
workflow_rules.next_status_hint: Used for the handoff action. Reordering statuses does not change this destination.
workflow_rules.policy_scope: Changes apply on the next entry. Existing executions keep their original instructions and handoff destination.
